470313.overview: 1942 is an unlicensed digital pinball table released for Visual Pinball based on Capcom's classic arcade shooter.

471902.overview:
300: Prepare for Glory pinball table is a virtual pinball table created for Future Pinball around 2008-2009. Designed by community creator Brad Bambara for a class project, it is an original table directly inspired by the gritty aesthetics and heroic themes of the 2007 blockbuster film 300 and the Frank Miller graphic novel that preceded it. 

The table heavily adopts the high-contrast, sepia-toned, and blood-red colour palette made famous by the film. Custom playfield art and backglass images feature King Leonidas, his Spartan warriors, and the invading Persian god-king, Xerxes. The artwork emphasizes the harsh environment and relentless combat of the Battle of Thermopylae. The table utilizes driving, cinematic music to match the high-intensity gameplay, and real audio assets from the movie, including Leonidas’ booming battle cries to pump up the player.

472368.overview:
The Fifth Element is an original table by ROM for Future Pinball, based on the 1997 science fiction movie starring Bruce Willis. Instead of a silver ball, the table incorporates an aspect of the film by using coloured "stones" or "elements" in the gameplay.

An updated version of the table was released in 2025 by RLR, adding a multiplayer mode and FizX3.3 physics.

473369.overview: An original table for Future Pinball that brings the high-stakes espionage of Daniel Craig’s first James Bond film to life. The table features classic music and sound effects from the James Bond film franchise, and casino-influenced visuals and gameplay.

474146.overview:
24: Collector's Edition is SLAMT1LT's Future Pinball mod of Stern's 2009 game. It includes additional sound, short video clips, and the rules and presentation have been changed from the original Stern version to make this game much more exciting.

You're Jack Bauer on a mission to save the Vice President, your daughter Kim and ultimately the world. When the game starts, your first objective is to interrogate the prisoner held in the Safe House. When he breaks he will give you information about the location and number of Snipers that line the route of the Vice President's motorcade. Hit the Bumpers a certain number of times to activate the Sniper Hurry Up and then hit the Left Ramp or Sniper Target to start Sniper Multiball Mode.  Kill 7 Snipers to collect the Super Jackpot.

Now the Terrorists have armed a Suitcase Nuke and you must find and defuse it.  Interrogate the Prisoner to get the disarm code or try and defuse the bomb yourself.  If you choose to defuse the bomb, you will start the countdown timer and the bomb will dentonate unless you cut the wires (flashing targets). You only have 30 seconds to disarm the bomb!  Chloe will give you more time if you need it.

After their failed attempted to take out the Vice President and detonate a Nuclear Bomb, the Terrorists take Jack's daughter (Kim) hostage in the Safe House (big mistake!).  Rescue Kim and kill all the remaining terrorists in the Safe House to beat the game and save the world!

477253.overview: This enhanced Future Pinball version of Maresa's 1976 bowling-themed table adds audio from the 1998 Coen brothers' movie "The Big Lebowski" and a modern-style DMD.  Maresa were a Spanish manufacturer, and the use of the flameco-heavy "Hotel California" by Gipsy Kings as in-game music gives the game a particular Spanish flair.
